conventions: Public interfaces and state models live in root package glowflow; default adapters live in defaults package.
Keep existing misspelled state.storeage filenames stable unless explicitly asked to rename them.
Tests in defaults package use miniredis, direct struct literals, reflect.DeepEqual, and t.Fatalf assertions.
Current Redis adapter constructor is NewRedisStorage(client *redis.Client) glowflow.StateStorage.
Use TDD: add failing Redis Lua/NOSCRIPT tests before editing production Redis storage code.

hard: Do not implement code during planning phase.
Use apply_patch for later file edits.
Do not revert unrelated user or formatter changes.
Do not wire StateStorage into Engine.
Replace Pipeline and TxPipeline usage in defaults/state.storeage.redis.go with embedded Lua scripts.
Move private helpers in defaults/state.storeage.redis.go onto redisStorage as methods.
Lua execution must reload and retry when Redis reports missing script cache.
soft: Keep changes scoped to defaults/state.storeage.redis.go, defaults/state.storeage.redis_test.go, defaults Lua assets, and go.mod/go.sum only if needed.
Preserve deterministic list ordering by sorting IDs before filtering and pagination.
Run go mod tidy only if a dependency changes.
compatibility: Missing state errors must preserve errors.Is compatibility with glowflow.ErrStateNotFound.
JSON round trips must preserve exported state fields used by existing tests.
NewRedisStorage public signature and return contract must remain stable.
security_requirements: Do not log Redis credentials or connection strings.
Do not add dynamic Lua generation from user data; pass keys and args through Redis script APIs.

patterns: Root package defines contracts; defaults package provides optional adapter implementations.
Redis adapter currently uses direct Redis commands for get/list and TxPipeline for save/delete.
List methods read index sets, sort IDs, fetch individual records, filter in Go, then paginate.
StateStorage is currently adapter-level; Engine integration is intentionally out of scope.

miniredis script-cache behavior must be verified; fallback test strategy may need real Redis or command-level error injection.
Moving all private helpers onto redisStorage may include pure helpers; execution should avoid package-level private helpers in the target file unless justified.

prior_decisions.decision: Treat the refactor as a standalone defaults Redis adapter change.
rationale: Planning scope explicitly excludes StateStorage interface and Engine wiring.

prior_decisions.decision: Add tests first for Lua/NOSCRIPT behavior before changing implementation.
rationale: Existing tests cover baseline behavior but not script cache reload.

rationale: User explicitly requested independent Lua files loaded with embed.
Only current pipeline sites are write/delete operations needing atomic multi-command behavior.

rationale: User explicitly requested private helpers become object methods.
